rules.alive: checkpoint observation_ts < the trade's own T0 terminal flip (same-instant rows excluded)
rules.state: mfe/mae_rung_by_s = highest T0-anchored ladder rung whose first passage <= s; cur_pnl_A = (last 1s close - E)/A
rules.remaining: rem_pnl_A = that checkpoint row's own executable entry -> the same opposite flip (gross, A)
rules.future_rung: P(T0-anchored rung reached later in the lifecycle | not yet reached by s)
